description:
Verifies the measured confirmation of the multicore before-after family and records its outcome as evaluated.

## Background

The confirmation addendum of the multicore before-after family is frozen from its accepted pilot and committed under `dev/active/ed3d490e-zen3-ldpc-frame-simd/`; the benchmark window runs the queued confirmation. Every timed run is one line of `dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/bench-window/queue.tsv`, executed in the overnight benchmark window; nothing timed runs in a working session. The [Zen 3 measurement contract](../1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/measurement-contract.md), the [frozen protocol](../f547c394/protocol.md) with its [version-4 amendment](../f547c394/amendment-v4.md) and the [worker brief](../1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/worker-brief.md) govern every cell.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The confirmation campaign is verified from its own append-only execution log with the shared campaign-log verifier, at the protocol's confirmatory pair count on fresh samples.
- [hard] REQ-02: The receipt is committed with its input snapshots, and the `benchmark-acceptance` verdict recomputed from the committed receipt reproduces the committed acceptance summary byte for byte.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each cell's decision and outcome are recorded as the evaluator records them, including fail, not-material, regressed, inconclusive and not-confirmatory; no margin is revised and no further attempt is queued after a non-passing outcome.
- [hard] REQ-04: The outcome states, per cell, whether the lane route qualifies at six and twelve physical cores and at twenty-four logical CPUs.
title: Collect the multicore before-after confirmation
